user_value: Kent obtains the QNow PoC acceptance receipt from one watched run on main, after the hosted runner lands through two reviewable PRs.
hypothesis: If we land the staging-qualification work on main in two credential-free PRs and then run the acceptance once from main under a fresh authorization receipt, then the PoC closes with a receipt an independent validation can read, without a reverse merge and without an unwatched first provider run.
wedge: Kent as FO on iamcxa/qnow only. This batch: DEV-114 first (merge station script, pre-batch blocker), then DEV-136 (support files PR), DEV-137 (hosted/ PR), DEV-36 rebased and merged, DEV-37 run once in a Conductor cloud workspace with the Captain watching. Not in it: DEV-132 (identity provider), the rest of the 48-commit branch not needed by hosted/.
outcome: main carries hosted/ and its supporting files with credential-free evidence; #1174 is merged onto it; DEV-37 produces docs/evidence/qnow-poc-acceptance-receipt.json in one run with cleanup census 0; every merge in the batch goes through merge-station.sh.
falsifier: Any of: a PR in the set needs a credential to pass its own checks; a merge lands outside merge-station.sh or on a non-trunk base; DEV-37 needs a second deploy or retry; the receipt names a secret, PII, URL or raw provider error; cleanup census non-zero.

premises.statement: Doing nothing leaves hosted/ only on a branch nobody drives, DEV-36 unmergeable and DEV-37 unrunnable from main.
The existing partial solution is the 48-commit branch and its 84-cycle record; kc-ship-flow's stations exist on main and a merge-station script is one ticket away.

Premise falsifier — remove the approach (land on main, then one watched run): the outcome cannot hold, because the runner cannot run from main and an unwatched first provider run is the risk DEV-36's own report named.

exit: DEV-114 merged and used for every merge in this batch.
DEV-136, DEV-137, DEV-36 merged on main with credential-free evidence.
DEV-37's acceptance receipt exists with cleanup census 0; DEV-37 Done.

journey.start: hosted/ exists only on a stale branch
journey.end: acceptance receipt in hand from a run on main
journey.observable: four merges through merge-station.sh, one DEV-37 run log, one receipt, census 0

issue_cut.note: DEV-114 is a kc-claude-plugins item riding as the pre-batch blocker; the receipt's code_repo is iamcxa/qnow and lists the four qnow items.
